server.name: io.github.streaik/Microsoft-OutlookCalendar
server.title: Microsoft Outlook Calendar
server.description: Read default calendar events in a date range using delegated Microsoft Graph access.

resources.name: upcoming-calendar-events
resources.title: Upcoming calendar events
resources.description: Lists the next 10 upcoming calendar events, including subject, start/end time, location, and organizer.

resources.name: list-calendars
resources.title: List calendars
resources.description: Get all calendars available to the signed-in user, including delegated/shared calendars.

resourceTemplates.name: events-in-date-range
resourceTemplates.title: Events in date range
resourceTemplates.description: Get all calendar events between a specific start and end date/time (e.g. 'today', 'next week').

resourceTemplates.name: events-in-date-range-other-user
resourceTemplates.title: Events in date range (other user)
resourceTemplates.description: Get all calendar events for another user between a start and end date/time. Requires delegate rights or access to shared mailbox.

resourceTemplates.name: upcoming-events
resourceTemplates.title: Upcoming events
resourceTemplates.description: Get the next {top} upcoming events from your default calendar.

resourceTemplates.name: outlook-calendar-details
resourceTemplates.title: Outlook calendar details
resourceTemplates.description: Get an Outlook calendar by ID, including ownership and editability details.

resourceTemplates.name: outlook-calendar-events-in-date-range
resourceTemplates.title: Outlook calendar events in date range
resourceTemplates.description: Get events from a specific Outlook calendar between a start and end date/time.

resourceTemplates.name: outlook-calendar-group-details
resourceTemplates.title: Outlook calendar group details
resourceTemplates.description: Get one Outlook calendar group by ID.

resourceTemplates.name: outlook-calendar-group-calendars
resourceTemplates.title: Calendars in Outlook calendar group
resourceTemplates.description: List calendars contained in a specific Outlook calendar group.

prompts.prompt: Give a daily agenda overview for {date}: list my meetings, the time and location of each, and indicate if any important emails or flagged tasks are related to these meetings.

template.name: daily-agenda-with-context
template.title: Daily agenda with context
template.description: Provides a schedule for a given date, enriched with related emails and tasks to help prepare.

arguments.name: date
arguments.description: The date for the agenda overview (format: YYYY-MM-DD).

prompts.prompt: Identify any upcoming calendar events in the next {days} days that involve the sender {emailAddress}, and summarize recent email threads with this person to prepare for the meetings.

template.name: meeting-prep-with-contact
template.title: Meeting prep with contact
template.description: Prepares user for meetings with a specific person by combining upcoming events and recent email context.

arguments.name: days
arguments.description: Number of days to look ahead in the calendar.

arguments.name: emailAddress
arguments.description: The email address of the contact.
